items.name: No save: A opens the save chooser, never an editor
items.game: Pokémon White 2 (with no White 2 save on the SD card)
items.do: Press A. Press B. Press +. Press B. Press Items on the HOME dock. Press B. Open Quick Games and choose White 2.
items.expect: Every route shows White 2's save chooser (Save Instances / file browser). Party, Boxes, Bag or the editor never open.

items.name: Gen I–III first open asks for a save once
items.game: Pokémon Red (or any Gen I–III game you have)
items.do: Press A. In Save Instances pick your Red save with A. Go back Home and press A again.
items.expect: First time: Save Instances opens and picking your save opens the game. Second time: the game opens directly.

items.name: Assigned save opens from every route
items.do: Press A, then B. Press +, then B. Press Items on the HOME dock, then B. Open it from Quick Games.
items.expect: Each route opens your Red save (the hub, the Game Workspace menu, the Bag). Never a different save.

items.name: Forget (unassign) a save
items.where: Red card → + → Source / Game File (or Save Instances)
items.do: Press − (Forget). Read the question and press Y. Back Home, press A on Red.
items.expect: Forget asks first; Y removes only the app's link. Red then shows the chooser again. The save file on the SD card is unchanged (same size and date).

items.name: Profile B never sees Profile A's save
items.where: Product Home, Profile A has saves assigned
items.do: Tap the profile icon and switch to Profile B. Press A and Items on Red. Then A and Items on Black 2.
items.expect: Profile B gets the chooser (or 'Matching saves belong to another profile'). Profile A's saves never open on Profile B.

items.name: Switching back keeps Profile A's assignment
items.do: Press Items on the HOME dock for Black 2. Then press A on Black 2.
items.expect: Items opens Black 2's Bag from A's Black 2 save (not a list of every DS save). The assignment is still there; no 'belongs to someone else' error.

items.name: Moved or renamed save is refused, not replaced
items.game: Any game with an assigned save
items.do: On a PC, rename the assigned save (keep a copy). Open PokeBank and press A on that game. Rename it back afterwards.
items.expect: The chooser opens and says the save is missing or moved. No other save is opened in its place.

items.name: Wrong game's save is refused
items.game: Pokémon White and White 2 (or Black / Black 2)
items.do: In White's file browser, pick a White 2 save file.
items.expect: Refused with a reason; White does not open with White 2's save.

items.name: Uninitialized emulator file is not editable
items.do: Start a new game in the emulator but quit before saving in-game, so the emulator makes an empty save. Pick that file in PokeBank.
items.expect: Shows 'not an initialized save'. Nothing opens and the file is unchanged.

items.name: First-boot White 2 offers no Add or Import
items.game: Pokémon White 2 save made before the first in-game save (no trainer yet)
items.do: Press A on an empty slot. Then press X.
items.expect: No Add Pokémon and no Import from file. The slot explains why (no trainer yet).

items.name: After a real save, Add and Import work
items.game: Pokémon White 2 after saving in-game once
items.do: Press A on an empty slot (Add Pokémon is listed). Press B. Press X (Import from file).
items.expect: Add Pokémon is offered; X opens Import from file. A and X agree.

items.name: Gen V Import lists only .pk5 / .ek5
items.where: Boxes → empty slot → X (Import from file)
items.do: Browse to a folder that also has .pk1/.pk3/.pk4 files (for example your Gen I import folder).
items.expect: Only .pk5 and .ek5 files are listed. Other generations' files do not appear.

items.name: Footers are the same in every game
items.do: Read the footer in each game. Press X (Add item) and read that footer.
items.expect: Same words everywhere: Navigate, A Edit Amount, X Add Item, Y Remove Item, L/R Category, ZR Top Up, + Review, − Help, B Back. Add picker: Navigate, Add / Select, Cancel, Page, Sort.

items.name: + opens Review from the game's main menu
items.where: Change one item amount, then B back to the game's main menu (hub)
items.do: Press +. Then press B.
items.expect: Review opens with your change; B returns to the main menu.

items.name: Crystal Add needs a Met Location
items.where: Boxes → empty slot → A → Add Pokémon
items.do: Pick a species and one move. Press B, then A (Keep / Add). Then open Location, pick a place, B, A.
items.expect: First A: 'Choose a Met Location before Add', nothing added. After choosing a location the Pokémon is added.

items.section: 4. Bag, Top Up, TMs and moves
items.name: Top Up says how many fit
items.where: Items → ZR → Bag + PC Items → Preview
items.do: Read the first lines, scroll the list, press A.
items.expect: Lines like 'Items: 30 native slots, 5 used. Only 25 fit; N missing items won't fit'. Every item listed once with a reason. A shows a Result list.

items.section: 4. Bag, Top Up, TMs and moves
items.name: Gen I TM tab adds TMs
items.where: Items → TM/HM tab → ZR → All Bag → Preview
items.do: Read the preview, press A, then +.
items.expect: The items being added are TMs/HMs, and the preview says the Bag has 20 slots shared by every category.

items.section: 4. Bag, Top Up, TMs and moves
items.name: Move chooser and moves still work
items.do: Open a move slot, pick a move, Keep, then Review.
items.expect: Only learnable moves are listed; the move change shows in Review.

items.name: Species change keeps the level
items.where: Edit an existing Lv 50 Rattata → Species
items.do: Change the species to Magikarp. Read the status line. Keep, then Review.
items.expect: Still Lv 50, note 'Kept Lv. 50; EXP 125000 -> 156250'. Review shows separate Species and Experience rows (no Level row).

items.name: Gen I species change keeps the level
items.where: Edit an existing Lv 50 Pikachu → Species
items.do: Change to Magikarp. Keep. Review. Export Copy.
items.expect: Still Lv 50; Review lists Species and Experience. Untouched Pokémon in the export are byte-identical (nothing else changed).

items.name: Event Pokémon say access unverified
items.where: Add Pokémon → Victini Lv 15 (Black) → Met Location
items.do: Read the Victini row and the Met evidence line. In Black 2, compare Regirock with Registeel.
items.expect: Victini: 'access unverified', evidence Incomplete (Liberty Pass). Black 2 Regirock is a normal row; Registeel says access unverified (Iron Key).

items.name: Unsupported characters are refused
items.do: On the ?123 page type A×B and press OK. Then type BOB and press OK.
items.expect: A×B is refused with a message and nothing changes. BOB is stored exactly.

items.name: Name follows Language
items.do: Change Language to Japanese, then Korean, then English.
items.expect: The name at the top changes to ピカチュウ, 피카츄, PIKACHU. Level and stats do not change.

items.name: Move and Clone
items.do: Y on a Pokémon, move to an empty slot, A. Then A → Clone, place the copy with A.
items.expect: Both land where chosen, with no pop-up; an occupied slot is never overwritten.

items.name: Review, Discard and Export Copy
items.do: Discard (B then Y), make one change again, then Export Copy.
items.expect: Discard asks first and restores everything. Export Copy says 'Verified copy exported: … (original save unchanged)'.

items.name: Touch carry places and cancels
items.do: Drag a finger over 2×2 Pokémon and lift. Tap an empty cell. Pick up again and tap outside the grid.
items.expect: The tap places the group (no pop-up); the outside tap returns it. The box arrows only change the box.

items.name: RetroArch quit diagnostic
items.do: Launch Red from PokeBank, then quit RetroArch. Note where you land and any error code. Copy sdmc:/switch/PokeBank-NX/runtime/last-launch.txt and any new file in sdmc:/atmosphere/crash_reports/.
items.expect: Not a fix: this collects evidence. Comment with: where you landed, error code, how you start PokeBank (Homebrew Menu / Album / forwarder), and attach last-launch.txt.
